summary: Comprehensive testing of Crypto Payment System completed. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: crypto payment modal, chain selection (BSC/Base/Polygon), token selection (USDT/USDC), converted USD amount display, and wallet connection step. MetaMask actual connection cannot be tested in automated environment but UI flow works correctly.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/crypto/chains - returns BSC, Base, Polygon chains with tokens
GET /api/crypto/price?amount_rub=X - converts RUB to USD without markup

POST /api/crypto/payment/create - creates Polygon USDC payment successfully
POST /api/crypto/payment/create - creates Base USDT payment successfully
GET /api/admin/crypto/settings - requires admin role (403 for user)
Crypto price conversion has no markup (markup_percent=0)

Crypto method can be selected (orange highlight)

Chain selection: BSC (BNB Smart Chain) visible
Wallet connect step shows 'Подключите кошелёк' message
frontend_admin_tests: Crypto wallet addresses section visible (ETH, BSC, BASE, TRC)
